cover.hookDraft: The 3 steps engineers use on every bug.
cover.lineDraft: Learn these three steps in your first year.

slides.label: Save this
slides.idea: Results first + save promise: a bug fixed with a passing test, and the 3 steps that got there.
slides.title: This is a bug fixed and proved with a test.
slides.line: Save these 3 steps for your next bug.
slides.screen: A terminal running a test file: one test 'empty cart returns 0' passing in green (PASS, 1 passed), cropped big

slides.label: Step 1 · Reproduce
slides.idea: Make it fail on purpose: write the exact input, expected vs actual, shrink to the smallest case.
slides.title: First, make the bug happen on purpose.
slides.line: Write the exact input, what you expected and what happened.
slides.screen: A GitHub-style issue / Notes bug report: Input, Expected, Actual rows for a fictional cart total bug

slides.label: Step 2 · Diagnose
slides.idea: Break a belief: pasting the error and asking AI to fix it isn't diagnosing; read the full error and print values first.
slides.title: AI guesses the fix when it can't see the cause.
slides.line: Read the full error and print values along the way.

slides.label: Step 2 · Diagnose
slides.idea: Re-hook: give AI the error, the code and what you expected, then read its change.
slides.title: Here's a better way to ask AI for a fix.
slides.line: Give it the error, the code and what you expected.
slides.screen: An AI chat panel: a prompt with the pasted error, the function and 'Expected: 0 for an empty cart', and a short answer pointing at one line

slides.label: Step 3 · Validate
slides.idea: Won't work unless: 'it runs' isn't proof; write a test for the exact bug and rerun after every change; check edge cases (empty, null, zero).
slides.title: This won't work unless you write a test.
slides.line: Test the exact bug, plus empty, null and zero.
slides.screen: A code editor with a small test file: three test cases (empty cart, null price, zero quantity), the first highlighted (.focus)

slides.label: Screenshot this
slides.idea: Cheat sheet: Reproduce (exact input, expected vs actual, smallest case), Diagnose (full error, print values, trace page → API → database), Validate (test the bug, edge cases, rerun).
slides.title: Here are the 3 steps on one screen.
slides.line: Screenshot it and use it on your next bug.
slides.screen: A Notes note 'Every bug' with 3 sections and 3 short rows each
